title: Patient Hardship Discount Program Renewal Terms and Hardship Payment Plan Qualification
content:
Renewal of a Patient Hardship Discount Program determination, and the link between a determination and the Hardship 24-Month Payment Plan, are set per level as follows.

| Level | Renewal application may be made from, calendar days before expiry | Renewal needs only a current benefits letter | Approved determination qualifies the patient for the Hardship 24-Month Payment Plan |
|---|---|---|---|
| Hardship Discount Level 1 (25%) | 30 | No (full income documents) | Yes |
| Hardship Discount Level 2 (50%) | 30 | No (full income documents) | Yes |
| Hardship Discount Level 3 (75%) | 30 | No (full income documents) | Yes |
| Hardship Discount Level 4 (100%) | 30 | No (full income documents) | Yes |
| Catastrophic Medical Hardship | 30 | No (full income documents) | Yes |
| Presumptive Eligibility Discount | 30 | Yes | Yes |

**Renewal window.** The figure in the first column is the number of calendar days before expiry from which a renewal application may be made; it is 30 at every level.

**Simplified renewal.** A renewal at the Presumptive Eligibility Discount needs only a current benefits letter rather than full income documents. At the five income-tested levels the column reads No, so a renewal there is not simplified in this way.

**Hardship payment plan qualification.** An approved determination at any of the six levels qualifies the patient for the Hardship 24-Month Payment Plan; the column reads Yes throughout.
